coreTests.name: Mana System
coreTests.description: Test the mana regeneration and consumption system
coreTests.steps:
1. Cast any spell to consume mana
2. Wait for mana to regenerate
3. Verify mana bar displays correctly
4. Test mana regeneration rate
5. Verify spell fails when out of mana

coreTests.name: Basic Spell Casting
coreTests.description: Cast spells using spellbooks and scrolls
coreTests.steps:
1. Equip a spellbook with spells
2. Cast a spell using right-click
3. Verify spell animation plays
4. Verify damage numbers display
5. Test spell cooldowns

coreTests.name: Spell Slot Management
coreTests.description: Test equipping and switching between spell slots
coreTests.steps:
1. Open spellbook inventory
2. Assign spells to different slots
3. Switch between slots in combat
4. Verify hotbar displays spell icons
5. Test spell slot limits

coreTests.name: Spell Level Scaling
coreTests.description: Test damage scaling with spell levels
coreTests.steps:
1. Obtain same spell at different levels
2. Compare damage output
3. Verify higher levels deal more damage
4. Test mana cost scaling
5. Verify level displays in tooltip

customTests.name: Master of All Schools
customTests.description: Use spells from all 9 magic schools
customTests.steps:
1. Collect spells from each school:
   - Fire, Ice, Lightning
   - Holy, Ender, Blood
   - Evocation, Nature, Eldritch
2. Cast at least one spell from each
3. Compare effectiveness against different enemies

customTests.name: Wizard Armor Basics
customTests.description: Test wizard armor protection and bonuses
customTests.steps:
1. Equip any wizard armor set
2. Take damage and verify protection
3. Check mana bonuses
4. Verify school-specific bonuses
5. Test set bonuses when full set equipped

customTests.name: Dead King Boss Fight
customTests.description: Defeat the Dead King boss in Catacombs
customTests.steps:
1. Find Catacombs structure
2. Navigate to boss room
3. Fight the Dead King
4. Dodge phase transitions
5. Loot unique drops

customTests.name: Weapon Imbuing
customTests.steps:
1. Obtain an imbue scroll
2. Apply to a sword/axe
3. Test the imbued weapon
4. Verify damage type changes
5. Test imbue duration
